newFileContributions.change: Provide runtime-validated versioned requests/results/error union for the eight specified discriminants. Compose trusted owner ports for Notes, Tasks, Files, schema/anchor mapping, policy and recovery. Preview computes a digest over exact raw source hashes, source-scoped origin map, attachment manifest, mapping policy, schema and destination revisions/epoch; it returns per-file raw-span diff, unknowns and collision/privacy/path/type diagnostics without filesystem/owner mutation. Apply accepts only the reviewed digest, revalidates actor/current source/destination revisions and performs owner commands with stable operation IDs. Persist only source-scoped origin mappings, original raw artifacts and import coordination/checkpoints under the approved owner journal, never copied Tasks or a second document authority. Resume reauthorizes and resolves native operation receipts before replay. Receipt success requires durable owner ACK and exact authorized ref/revision/hash readback; failures and indeterminate outcomes remain separate from imported count.

risks: Root-owned uncommitted wave0 work and later accepted dependencies can invalidate line/symbol/hash evidence; do not overwrite or reset it.
Spec baseline e953786 and linked published baseline 249b3b4 are not current requested input; publication receipts are not feature readiness.
Current task persistence lacks atomic expectedRevision and fsynced durable owner receipt. Import-side locks not shared by normal task writers cannot fix that guarantee.
Markdown store preserves native CAS/replay but current writeNative composition uses random IDs and private recovery services; create/resume cannot safely reuse it without approved owner port.

Current markdownRevision hashes UTF-8 strings and index excludes hidden/provenance paths; raw byte/attachment preservation and unknown-format diagnostics need dedicated source manifest, not index-as-authority.

Legacy importAsset lexical containment, symlink reads, suffix naming and provided MIME are insufficient for secured idempotent attachment mapping. Attachment licenses require a separate source/license audit.

A component with no existing route and typed transport integration is not the RD-12 feature. Normative shared path list is insufficient for known channel/mount/i18n integration without lead approval.

Native invalidation can occur before import-level readback in current composition. Accepted revision-fenced index activation must be reconciled with owner changed delivery, not suppressed or replaced by a second index.
